# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This folder contains focused instruction files for CV optimization.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `main.md` | Core operating principles and workflow |
| `ats-rules.md` | ATS optimization and formatting rules |
| `bullet-engineering.md` | Bullet point structure and action verbs |
| `zero-hallucination.md` | Verification policy and forbidden actions |
| `skills-inventory.md` | Verified skills, experiences, projects |
| `summary-writing.md` | Professional summary guidelines |

## Usage

Copilot automatically loads `../copilot-instructions.md` which references these files.
The cv_agent Python package handles all optimization logic.
